latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Cold Call Script Generator skill.

- Generates personalized cold call scripts, voicemail templates, and outbound email openers for B2B sales teams and founder-led sales.
- Incorporates real prospect research, pain hypothesis generation (tiered by signal strength), and objection handling.
- Features pattern-interrupt opening frameworks and tone calibration based on ideal customer profile (ICP).
- Supports building full multi-touch outbound sequences and customized opener variations.
- Triggered by requests such as "cold call script", "voicemail script", "cold email opener", "outbound cadence", and similar sales prospecting prompts.
